title: LgWSC Domestic Metered Water Tariff Schedule
content: Lukanga Water Supply and Sanitation Company (LgWSC) Domestic Metered Tariff rates are based on the schedule for Central Province, Zambia. volumetric tiers: Tier 1 (Lifeline Block): 0 to 6 cubic meters (m³) per month costs ZMW 3.50 per cubic meter. Tier 2 (Standard Use): 6 to 15 cubic meters (m³) per month costs ZMW 8.20 per cubic meter. Tier 3 (Higher Use): 15 to 30 cubic meters (m³) per month costs ZMW 14.50 per cubic meter. Tier 4 (Heavy Use): greater than 30 cubic meters (m³) per month costs ZMW 22.00 per cubic meter. Fixed meter charge is ZMW 15.00 per month, and Sanitation Surcharge is 2.5% of the water subtotal charge.

title: LgWSC Domestic Unmetered Water Flat Rates
content: Lukanga Water Supply and Sanitation Company (LgWSC) domestic unmetered flat rates depend on the housing area density and cost: Low-cost housing areas flat rate is ZMW 85.00 per month. Medium-cost housing areas flat rate is ZMW 145.00 per month. High-cost housing areas flat rate is ZMW 220.00 per month.

title: LgWSC Commercial and Institutional Metered Tariff Schedule
content: Lukanga Water Supply and Sanitation Company (LgWSC) Commercial / Institutional Metered Tariff rates for businesses, industries, schools, and hospitals: Block 1: 0 to 10 cubic meters (m³) per month costs ZMW 12.00 per cubic meter. Block 2: 10 to 30 cubic meters (m³) per month costs ZMW 18.50 per cubic meter. Block 3: 30 to 60 cubic meters (m³) per month costs ZMW 26.00 per cubic meter. Block 4: greater than 60 cubic meters (m³) per month costs ZMW 35.00 per cubic meter. Fixed meter charge is ZMW 25.00 per month, and Sanitation Surcharge is 2.5% of the water subtotal charge.

title: LgWSC Water Kiosks and Communal Standpipes Tariff
content: Lukanga Water Supply and Sanitation Company (LgWSC) Water Kiosks and Communal Standpipes use a subsidized flat rate of ZMW 0.50 per 20-litre container.
